### Item 1 — what the user expresses, simulator behaviour

- Opening (script): a letter says her "federal unemployment is almost used up", she "filed an application for extended benefits online last Tuesday", and wants "the agency to get your extended benefits set up today. That is the only thing you ask for."
- Identification: name + phone 6085551437, then SSN last4 1468 and DOB 1968-02-14 on request. `find_customers` → customer_id `13826ab0-dd25-4320-ac55-f52ef096fcbf`; `verify_caller_identity` (phone, last4, DOB) → "Identity verified ... (3 detail(s) matched)".
- Authorization: "If the agent asks whether the agent may go ahead with anything it needs to record on your claims, you say yes"; "If the agent mentions a correction payment on your old claim, you say that is fine."
- Passive/conditional facts: second dependent (grandson) added at the beginning of September (only if asked about family); account takeover at end of August, returned deposit, fraud unit "confirmed your identity on September 10 and told you your payments would go by paper check for now" (only if asked about bank/fraud).
- User-owned action: "If the agent explains that you must yourself make a new payment election before something can be paid, you agree ... deposited to your new checking account; once the agent hands you the step ... you carry it out yourself with exactly the choice of a checking account and the lead time the agent gives you, and you read back the effective date it shows." The simulator executes the handed-over tool only; it never proposes steps or numbers.

### Item 4 — formulas, tiers and values

**(a) Dependency redetermination on the parent** (docs "Computation of the Dependency Redetermination Credit" + factors).
- Per-dependent amount: factor "Family Rates per Dependent on a Dependency Redetermination": "Two or more | At least 182 calendar days before the handling date | 18.00". Dependents on record 2; age 2026-01-25 → 2026-09-15 = 233 days → 18.00. Computed allowance 18.00 × 2 = 36.00.
- Ceiling: factor "Ceiling on a Redetermined Dependency Allowance by Age of the Determination": "More than 90 days | 0.075 (7.5 percent) of the weekly benefit amount". Determination date 2026-01-30 → 228 days → 0.075 × 450.00 = 33.75. Redetermined allowance = lesser = **33.75**.
- Increase 33.75 − 15.00 = 18.75.
- Weeks: factor "Credited Weeks When Dependents Are Added": "13 or more | The remaining benefit balance divided by the weekly benefit amount plus the dependency allowance on the claim, rounded up". 31 weekly payments; 150.00 / 465.00 = 0.32 → 1 week. 1 × 18.75 = 18.75.
- Wage cap fraction: factor "Steady-Earner Wage Cap Fraction": standard base period; BPW 36093.61 ≥ 3.0 × 11700.00 = 35100.00; entitlement credited 12030.00 ≥ wage-capped amount floor(0.3333 × 36093.61 = 12030.0002) = 12030 → 0.36. Cap 0.36 × 36093.61 − 12030.00 = 963.70.
- Credit = floor(min(18.75, 963.70)) = **18.00**. Call: `dependency_allowance 33.75`, `amount 18.00`. Return: MBA 12048.00, remaining 168.00, determination 2, date 2026-09-15.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, program figures 15.00/3/26/0.3333): allowance 30.00, increase 15.00, 26 × 15.00 = 390.00, cap 0.3333 × 36093.61 − 12030.00 = 0.0002 → floor = 0 → credit 0 (no positive amount can even be passed). Definite and different from 18.

**(b) Payment election lead time** (doc "Payment Election Lead Time" baseline 2 business days from the facet "Payment method change lead time … 2 business days").
- Prenote days: factor "Direct Deposit Prenote Days": "A deposit on the claim was returned by the bank within the 6 months before the handling date | 5"; cancellation reason returned_by_bank dated 2026-09-03 → +5.
- Verification days: factor "Verification Days on a Payment Election after Recent Identity Verification": "An Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification case on the claim was verified within the 30 days before the handling date | 3"; verified 2026-09-10 (5 days) → +3.
- Review days: factor "Review Days after a Recent Payment Method Change": "No more than 30 days before the handling date | 3"; payment_method_effective_date 2026-09-10 → +3.
- Alignment: factor "Aligning a Payment Election to the Payment Cycle": latest payment by issue date = 2026-09-10 weekly, paper_check → "Rounded up to a whole multiple of the paper-check cycle of 5 business days", applied "Last".
- 2 + 5 + 3 + 3 = 13 → **15** business days. Effective date returned by the tool: **2026-10-06**.
- Fall-back: 2 (effective 2026-09-17).

**(c) Supplemental payment for week ending 2026-09-05** (doc "Correct Payable Amount of a Corrected Week and the Supplemental Figure" + factors), using the claim's allowance after (a) = 33.75.
- Disregard share: factor "Earnings Disregard Share for Attached Workers on a Supplemental Correction": approved_training enrolled; attachment hours on certifications with week ending within 2026-06-15..2026-09-15 = 16.0+17.0+16.5+18.0+18.5+17.5+19.0+17.0+18.0+16.5+17.5+17.0 = 208.5 ≥ 100 → 0.5 → disregard 225.00. Earnings above 300.00 − 225.00 = 75.00.
- Threshold: factor "Full-Time Hours Threshold for a Supplemental Correction": separation reduced_hours → 36 hours.
- Partial-hours rate: factor "Partial-Hours Earnings Rates on a Supplemental Correction": 17.0 < 0.5 × 36 = 18.0 → 0.5 × 75.00 = 37.50.
- Pension: factor "Pension Deductions on a Supplemental Correction": claimant-contributed 96.00 ≤ 0.25 × 450.00 = 112.50 → (96.00 − 0.1 × 450.00 = 51.00) × 0.50 = 25.50.
- Correct payable = floor(450.00 + 33.75 − 37.50 − 25.50 = 420.75) = 420.00. Already paid for the week: 252.00. 168.00, capped by remaining 168.00 → **168.00**. Kind `supplemental`, week 2026-09-05, method **paper_check** (method in force on the payment date: the new election takes effect 2026-10-06; "payments issued on or after it use the elected method"; worked row "A payment issued on the Thursday … still uses the method in force before the election"). Return: remaining 0.00, status **exhausted**.
- Excluded distractors: the misreported-earnings integrity reduction (overpayment determined 2026-09-09) is scoped "For a weekly payment" / "For a waiting-week value" only, not to a supplemental correction; the recall-date disregard is weekly-payment-only (and recall_date is blank).
- Fall-back (computation doc only, allowance 33.75): disregard 135.00, earnings deduction 165.00, pension 48.00 → floor(270.75) = 270 − 252 = 18.00. Different from 168.

**(d) EB first determination** (doc "Extended Benefits Maximum Benefit Amount from the Parent Claim" + factors).
- Wage-weeks test: BPW 36093.61 ≥ 40 × 450.00 = 18000.00 → met.
- Regular benefits paid on the parent after (c): 12124.00 + 168.00 − 244.00 = 12048.00.
- Measure: factor "Overpayments against a Parent Claim…": no fraud overpayment; one non-fraud at status established principal 274.00 → 12048.00 − 274.00 = 11774.00.
- Fraction: factor "Schedule of Extended Benefits Fractions by Parent Claim Attachment": 31 weekly payments ≥ 20; BPW ≥ 60 × 450.00 = 27000.00 → 0.52. 0.52 × 11774.00 = 6122.48.
- 13 × (450.00 + 33.75) = 6288.75. Lesser 6122.48 → floor 6122.00.

- MBA = 6122.00 + 967.00 = **7089.00**; WBA **450.00**, DA **33.75** (copied from the parent). Return: status active, MBA 7089.00, remaining 7089.00.
- Fall-back (computation doc only, after the prerequisites): 0.5 × 12048.00 = 6024.00 vs 6288.75 → 6024.00. Different from 7089.

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible materials alone

Problems: P0 EB first determination (root, asked); P1 dependency redetermination of the parent; P2 claimant payment-method election on the parent (user); P3 supplemental payment for the parent's last paid week.

- Hop P0 → P3 (state-derived). Sentence in the EB hub: "The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is fixed only after the parent claim's last paid week carries a supplemental payment for its shortfall." + "Both are states of the parent claim's records: the payment history of its last paid week…". Records: parent ledger for week 2026-09-05 shows only a weekly 252.00 entry. Searching "supplemental payment" / "paid short" finds "Supplemental Payments on Unemployment Benefit Claims Weeks Paid Short", which "corrects the most recent week for which a weekly payment was issued on the claim … owed whenever that week was paid less than its correct payable amount" and whose write adds a payment entry for that week. Base sequencing point 2 (parent must be exhausted) is closed by the same write: the supplemental "is debited from the claim's remaining balance, and a claim whose remaining balance reaches zero shows status exhausted".
- Hop P0 → P1 (state-derived). Sentence in the EB hub: "The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is not fixed until the parent claim's dependency allowance counts every dependent added to the record." Records: parent dependents_count 2 vs DA 15.00 = one × the UCFE per-dependent 15.00 (facet "Dependency Allowance Rates"); persona (if asked) added a grandson in September. Search "dependency allowance" + "dependents added" finds "Dependency Redetermination on Unemployment Benefit Claims": "issued on … a claim whose dependents on record exceed the dependents its current dependency allowance was set for … sets the claim's dependency allowance to the redetermined figure".
- Hop P3 → P1 (state-derived). Supplemental hub: "A supplemental correction is computed only once the claim's dependency allowance counts every dependent added to the record." Same resolution as above.
- Hop P3 → P2 (state-derived). Supplemental hub: "A supplemental payment is not issued until the claim carries a payment method election recorded after the latest identity theft re-verification of the claimant was verified." Records: ITVR case verified 2026-09-10; parent payment_method paper_check with effective date 2026-09-10 and no later election visible (no claim requests; ledger has no method-change entry); persona: the fraud unit put her on paper check. Search "payment method election" finds "Claimant Payment Method Election": "When the claimant elects how benefits … are paid, the election records the new payment method and the payment method effective date"; "The claimant makes this election personally … a claimant-side tool".
- Order: P1 and P2 (any order) → P3 → P0. P1 before P3 also because the corrected week's correct payable amount uses "the dependency allowance on the claim" and the supplemental is capped by the remaining balance (168.00 only after the credit); P3 before P0 because the parent entitlement measure counts "every payment issued on it" and the parent must be exhausted; P1 before P0 because the EB claim copies the parent's DA and the training-week value turns on the age of the parent's latest determination.
- No hop is pre-solved: each blocked hub states only a record state; the only tool named in each hub is its own.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternatives excluded by visible text: (i) supplemental by direct deposit — excluded by "payments issued on or after [the effective date] use the elected method" and the Thursday row of the lead-time table (effective date 2026-10-06 > 2026-09-15); (ii) corrected week = 2026-08-29 reissue — excluded by "most recent week for which a weekly payment was issued … read by issue date" and "reissues are not weekly payments"; (iii) misreported-earnings disregard reduction in the supplemental — excluded by its scope ("For a weekly payment", "For a waiting-week value"); (iv) program threshold 32 for the corrected week — excluded by "36 hours … when the separation recorded on the claim is reduced hours"; (v) EB fraction 0.5 — excluded by the 20-payment / 60×WBA tier; (vi) parent measure without the overpayment — excluded by "one or more non-fraud overpayments at status established"; (vii) training value with half allowance — excluded because the parent's latest determination is dated today after P1.
- "Do only the one thing": calling the EB determination first leaves a parent at status active (sequencing point 2 forbids an eligible EB determination), a last paid week with no supplemental entry, and a parent allowance counting one of two dependents — all three states the EB hub says must hold before the amount is fixed. Excluded by visible principles and records, not by any route.
- Calculation fall-backs recorded above (credit 0 vs 18; lead 2 vs 15; supplemental 18 vs 168; EB 6024 vs 7089). Factor findability: every factor doc was reached from record words — "dependents on record"/"effective date"/"monetary determination date"/"weekly payments issued"/"base period used" (claim + ledger); "returned by the bank" (ledger cancel_reason), "Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification" (IDV case variant), "payment method effective date" (claim), "paper check" (ledger); "approved training enrolled"/"hours" (claim + certifications), "reduced hours" (separation_reason), "claimant-contributed pension" (certification other_pay_type); "Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error established" (overpayment record), "weekly payments on the parent"/"base-period wages", "approved training", "latest monetary determination". No computation document announced a variation.
- Blind-side observations (not verdicts yet): the factor "Family Rates per Dependent…" ends "the redetermined allowance before any other limit is 18.00 times 3" (alludes to another limit); several factor documents share terms defined only in sibling factor documents ("counted earnings", "hours base", "the value of a training week"); the facet "Entitlement Duration…" labels the EB 0.5 as a fraction "of the parent's maximum benefit amount" while the governing EB document applies the fraction to the parent entitlement measure (benefits paid); the facet "Qualifying Terms…" still lists "Extended Benefits (EB): 20 weeks of full-time employment in the base period" while the EB entitlement document lists that requirement as a retired clause and the EB amount document restates it as a 40×WBA wage equivalent. To be judged after reveal.
